terms.comment: Classically the provisions market (see market); Andresian uses it for a supermarket.

phrases.latin: Postrēmō superīnstitōrium adiērunt, tabernam illam vāstam in quā mercēs longīs ōrdinibus dispositae sunt
phrases.english: Last of all they went to the supermarket, that huge shop where the goods are laid out in long rows

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 131, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
